title: Replication Archive: Technological Modernization Fails to Improve Fleet Capacity Utilization in Turkish Marine Capture Fisheries
description: Replication archive, audited panel datasets (2000–2024), R (deaR) Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) capacity utilization and Malmquist TFP models, and Python panel econometric scripts (Driscoll-Kraay spatial HAC, Prais-Winsten AR(1) FGLS) accompanying the manuscript 'Technological Modernization Fails to Improve Fleet Capacity Utilization in Turkish Marine Capture Fisheries' submitted to ICES Journal of Marine Science (ICESJMS-2026-474).
